counterfactual_missing_items: Best-corrected visual acuity was +2 logMAR (hand movement) OD
Progression from discrete right papillary edema to severe optic nerve atrophy
decisive_items: Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2
response.rationale: R5 uniquely combines the positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR with core optic neuritis signs (RAPD, central scotoma, impaired color/contrast), matching the most likely diagnosis. C1 is the runner-up because it adds right-eye laterality and subsumes R1, but it lacks the causal SARS-CoV-2 link. R7/R3/R6 are partial or unsupported; R2 has no raw support.

rejected.why: Optic neuritis signs alone; subsumed by C1 and lacks laterality and SARS-CoV-2 cause.
No raw support spans; positive PCR appears only in generator assessment, not raw evidence.
Uveitis findings are present but do not explain optic nerve dysfunction or the SARS-CoV-2 association.
Negative/weak serologies do not establish viral retinitis; no raw support for retinal infection.
Retinal vasculitis is a component but not the primary optic neuritis diagnosis; lacks cause and optic nerve signs.
